label: Test by PrussPowerPremises.twoMemberCollective (259571ae)
note: Tests whether the route has a model with two contingent concreta at the origin even when powers for individual absence fail. In twoMemberG, c and d are present and contingent at (true, true). The concrete g holds the joint-absence power there and is present at accessible (false, false), where both members are absent. The model jointly witnesses all five nonlogical premises. The argument separately assumes excluded middle.
